title: Konductor run-state document
description: Schema for a Konductor run-state document: one execution of the (not-yet-implemented, M5) run-engine/conductor against a project's gates. This schema applies ONLY to run-engine (M5) invocations -- doctor, install, synth, init, and config never produce or consume a run-state document. This M1 stage does not read, write, or validate any run-state document -- init/config code paths never touch `.konductor/runs/`. This schema is authored now, ahead of the run-engine, purely as the AGREED SHAPE downstream milestones (M5) will produce/consume, so the config loader's `tier`/`severities` vocabulary and this shape stay consistent from the start. DECISION: JSON Schema (not a documented plain example) was chosen because a validator is cheap to add on both sides without new heavy deps -- Rust already gains `serde_json` (pre-existing) for `__dump_schema`, and Python's stdlib `json` module (already used ad hoc in cli.py) is sufficient for basic shape checks; neither side needs a full JSON Schema validation LIBRARY (e.g. jsonschema/valico) for this milestone, since no code here actually validates a run-state document yet -- this file documents the target shape for M5 to implement against.

schema_version.description: Run-state document schema version. Bump when the shape changes incompatibly.

run_id.description: Opaque unique identifier for this run, e.g. a ULID or UUID.

started_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run began.

completed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run finished, or null while still in progress.

status.description: Coarse run outcome. Mirrors the exit-code contract's meanings (see cli/README.md's Conventions table) but is a STATUS STRING, not an exit code -- translating this to a process exit code is exclusively the run-engine's job (M5), never this M1 stage's.

tier.description: The single tier (from cli/gate-config/scope-table.yml) active for this run.

findings.description: Findings emitted during this run, one entry per gate result.

phase.description: Phase name (from the active tier's `phases` list in scope-table.yml) this finding was evaluated under.

severity.description: Must be one of severity-schema.yml's ids.

resource.description: Path or identifier of the resource this finding is about, if applicable.

findings.message: IAM policy grants Action: '*' on Resource: '*'.
